rule: This file records where shared English learning/runtime work should continue. It is not exam/source truth, not private learner state, and not a substitute for LEARNING_CONTRACT.md or module contracts. A fresh Chat must read the shared Learning Contract first, then the relevant module owner(s), before proposing new English work.
completed_shared_work: English Current consolidation completed: concise manifest, provenance separation, canonical exam/source assets, and Current-only Astro gating.

Global English LEARNING_CONTRACT.md is the common cross-module learning authority: ability formation before material/UI organization; Clean Attempt; first meaningful failure; smallest sufficient repair; reconstruction/re-execution; selective memory admission; later fresh transfer as stronger mastery evidence.
English capability architecture is frozen as four ability lines (Lexical / Reading / Translation / Writing) plus task-specific trainers rather than one equal system per exam section.
Objective Runtime v1 is frozen for Cloze / Reading A / Reading B at content/english/modules/objective-runtime.md.
Frozen objective review-unit rule: training evidence may be question/blank/placement-level, but learner-Chat review is passage/set-level. Evidence granularity may be smaller than Review granularity.

Objective passage/set Review Packet v1 is defined: complete unit identity + attempt summary + compact outcome map for every item + expanded content only for wrong/unanswered/uncertain items + whole-unit diagnosis before repair threads.
Objective state logic is frozen: ATTEMPT -> PASS or REPAIR_NEEDED -> ROOT_CAUSE (Lexical / Reading / task-specific) -> REPAIR -> TRANSFER_PENDING -> later unseen transfer -> CLOSED.

Cloze cognitive object is Slot Constraint -> Best Fit; Reading A is comprehension -> decisive evidence -> option adjudication; Reading B is Discourse Reconstruction with local/coupled/structure repair and cascade merging.

Cloze and Reading B Current learner runtimes are materialized from canonical question_bank.v1.json with answer-gated clean attempts, set navigation, whole-passage/set Chat handoff, Current-only section resolution, and build/validation gates.
Reading B canonical candidate inventory is resolved from set.context.shared_option_pool; Current QA confirmed cloze=27 sets/530 questions and reading_part_b=22 sets/110 positions before build.
Reading A Current learner runtime has passage-level Chat handoff; legacy per-question copy-to-Chat is demoted in normal flow while question objects remain internal evidence/repair slices.

Objective Evidence / Transfer Runtime v1 is established at content/english/modules/objective-evidence-runtime.md. A question is an evidence event; the durable tracked object is a repair thread / transfer claim rather than the historical question.

Objective review return protocol uses KIANOS_OBJECTIVE_RETURN_V1 with schema kianos.english.objective_review_return.v1. Chat returns whole-unit repair threads, optional task-specific newClaims, and claimUpdates for active claims.

Task-specific transfer claims are private/device-local under kianos-english-objective-transfer-claims-v1. Lexical/Reading root causes are routed to their ability owners and are not duplicated into the objective claim store.

Transfer closure is deliberately Chat-mediated rather than using N-pass counters. Later handoff packets carry active claims; Chat decides whether fresh material actually tests the same behavior before CLOSED / TRANSFER_PENDING / REOPENED.
Clean objective attempts remain low-friction: when there is no pending claim, no Chat handoff is required; when pending claims exist, a quiet optional transfer-check handoff may appear.

Cloze, Reading A, and Reading B pages now share ObjectiveTransferClaims for Chat-return import and private claim state. Cloze/Reading B ObjectiveHandoff and Reading A ReadingPassageHandoff include ACTIVE TRANSFER CLAIMS plus the return protocol.

Reading A no longer loads the legacy ReadingReviewSignals, ReadingTransferEvidence, or ReadingSessionTransferEvidence components, so Current stops creating/updating per-question WATCH transfer state. Old local WATCH data is not automatically migrated.

Objective Evidence / Transfer v1 passed both Current CI gates on commit 2df83d0fa52e031efe971d7fa3ac1275356beaf6: Static Web Objective QA passed validate:objective plus Astro build; English Objective Runtime passed source inventory plus Astro build.

Translation has one canonical learner asset at content/english/modules/translation.md organized as Global Map -> four dense Core Learning Blocks -> Skill Map -> selective Skill Content -> Material Routing -> learner-facing learning loop -> frozen Translation Runtime v1. First learning happens through the dense Core Blocks, not by clicking through a taxonomy.

Translation freezes an adaptive Chat expansion boundary: shared static content must remain clear, plain-language, and information-dense enough to support independent real-task entry; complex ambiguities, interacting mechanisms, rare structures, alternative faithful reconstructions, and personalized micro-drills are expanded in Chat when real evidence makes them valuable rather than being preloaded as encyclopedia content.

Objective tasks now have a canonical first-learning asset at content/english/modules/objective-learning.md, modeled on the successful Translation asset philosophy without copying Translation cognition. It teaches an Objective Global Map first, then task-specific dense Core Learning Blocks, then Skill Maps as diagnostic addresses, then only a few high-value starter Skill Contents before Runtime.

Objective first-learning asset defines Cloze as Slot Demand -> Constraint Stack -> Candidate Competition -> Passage Execution; Reading A as Question Demand -> Decisive Evidence/Boundary -> Option Proposition -> Adjudication/Execution; Reading B as Discourse Skeleton -> Position Demand -> Candidate Role/Cohesion -> Global Reconciliation.

Objective Skill Maps are explicitly not first-learning task lists or teacher question-type curricula. They exist for later evidence aggregation, Chat diagnosis, and selective repair. Static content owns stable high-value mental models; Chat owns real ambiguity, interacting mechanisms, rare boundaries, learner-specific micro-drills, and transfer adjudication.

A shared learner page at /objective-learn/ renders the canonical objective-learning.md directly through marked rather than duplicating learning semantics in Astro. It provides in-page Global Map / Cloze / Reading A / Reading B navigation plus direct return links to practice.

Cloze, Reading A, and Reading B homes now expose a lightweight optional First Learning entry to the relevant anchor while preserving Continue Practice as the normal low-friction path. First Learning is not a compulsory gate before practice.

Objective first-learning owner/readiness is registered in content/english/manifest.json and validate:objective now includes a dedicated first-learning validation for owner registration, asset structure, learner page, and all three home links.

Objective first-learning v1 passed Static Web Objective QA on commit 14de0bb557e41a49d996e2e277099a19b0c44712: objective runtime validation, objective-learning validation, and Astro build all passed. The independent English Objective Runtime workflow also passed source inventory and Astro build on the same commit.

Translation Runtime v1 remains whole-task/set review with finer internal evidence, first-meaningful-failure routing, cascade collapse, learner reconstruction before full reference when possible, selective memory admission, and fresh/unseen transfer for closure.
Writing currently inherits the shared Learning Contract until its own module contract is frozen.

KianOS SYSTEM_CONTRACT.md shared learner-surface baseline remains authoritative: Current / Continue / Navigate / Repair / Verify-Transfer / Handoff / Deferred / Validation with non-isomorphic cognition per lane.

translation.inheritance: Translation inherits shared English principles and its own dense learner-asset architecture plus frozen Translation Runtime v1. Static Translation assets teach the stable high-value model clearly enough for independent task entry; Chat provides adaptive depth for real ambiguity, mechanism interaction, alternative reconstruction, and learner-specific repair. Objective assets do not redefine Translation cognition or review state.

writing.inheritance: Writing inherits all shared English learning/evidence/mastery/memory/UI principles. Writing A and Writing B are modes within one Writing ability line. Do not copy objective-task review mechanics into Writing merely for UI consistency.
writing.current_owner_status: No Writing-specific module contract is frozen yet.

objective_tasks.inheritance: First learning uses Objective Global Map -> task-specific Core Learning Blocks -> Skill Map -> selective Skill Content. Practice then uses the frozen passage/set-level Objective Runtime. Question-level evidence may support diagnosis, but durable objective transfer state is claim-level. Skill Maps are diagnostic addresses, not compulsory curricula. Chat adjudicates semantic transfer and adaptive long-tail depth; the browser stores private state and must not manufacture mastery from arbitrary counters.

next_action.instruction: Stop adding objective infrastructure or expanding the Skill Maps merely for completeness. Real validation should now test both layers. Choose one genuine task lane, read its Global Model + four Core Learning Blocks from /objective-learn/, then immediately enter a real clean passage/set. Observe whether the framework changes the learner's actual decision process without creating management overhead. If the attempt contains wrong/unanswered/uncertain evidence, continue through the existing whole-unit Chat review and KIANOS_OBJECTIVE_RETURN_V1 path. Only actual learner friction, missing high-value mental models, or wrong semantic behavior should trigger asset/UI/runtime revision.
learner_validation_sequence: Enter one task through First Learning and read only its Global Model + four Core Blocks; do not pre-study the whole Skill Map as a checklist.
Immediately do one genuine clean passage/set from Current and notice whether the intended cognitive actions are actually callable under task conditions.
If stable clean: PASS and continue; do not manufacture review debt merely to test the system.
If wrong/unanswered/uncertain: use the whole-unit Chat packet and diagnose primary vs dependent causes before local repair.
Use Skill Map only after evidence exists, to give the exposed mechanism a stable address; expand starter/Chat content only when it changes the next action.
Route Lexical/Reading roots outward; persist only justified task-specific transfer claims.
On later fresh material, use optional TRANSFER_CHECK only when an active claim is genuinely tested.

Record concrete learner friction separately: too abstract, too verbose, missing example, unclear decision action, UI interruption, or an unnecessary management step. Revise only from those observations.

do_not_reopen_without_new_evidence: Do not reopen English Objective Runtime v1 merely because a UI implementation is inconvenient or a source uses a different taxonomy.
Do not make the learner review objective questions one-by-one in Chat; passage/set is the minimum user-facing review unit.
Do not restore per-question WATCH signals as the durable Reading A transfer object.
Do not automatically migrate legacy question-level WATCH state into claim-level transfer state.
Do not close a transfer claim merely because N later questions/passages were correct; relevance and evidence quality matter.
Do not duplicate Lexical or Reading ability objects inside the objective task claim store.
Do not create a task claim for every wrong question or every one-off hesitation.
Do not show formal answers or diagnostic assets before a clean attempt.
Do not require manual error taxonomy, notes, or claim creation for every question.
Do not make stable-correct objective items enter full review by default.
Do not force one failure taxonomy or one review-card shape across all English modules.

Do not turn Objective Skill Maps into a compulsory first-learning taxonomy or teacher question-type course. First learning must remain Global Map + dense Core Blocks; the Skill Map becomes useful after real evidence exists.
Do not make First Learning a gate that blocks direct practice or Continue. It is a capability-building entry, not a compliance step.
Do not reduce Objective first-learning content to a thin taxonomy merely because Chat is available; the static asset must independently teach the stable high-value model.

Do not pre-expand Objective first-learning into an encyclopedia of distractor types, discourse labels, or rare boundaries merely for completeness; use real learner evidence to trigger adaptive Chat depth or selective Skill Content expansion.
Do not reduce Translation first-learning content to a thin taxonomy merely because Chat is available; the static asset must independently teach the stable high-value model.
Do not pre-expand Translation into an encyclopedia of rare boundaries merely for completeness; use real learner evidence to trigger adaptive Chat depth or selective Skill Content expansion.
Do not create more module/governance files merely for completeness; create a specific owner only for a genuine shared cognitive/runtime object.

continuation_policy.update_when: Update at meaningful English shared-work stage transitions or when the next active module/action changes materially.
continuation_policy.fresh_chat_rule: Read main@HEAD CURRENT.md, this continuation file, content/english/LEARNING_CONTRACT.md, and only the Current module owners needed for the active task. Objective work must additionally read objective-learning.md, objective-runtime.md, and objective-evidence-runtime.md. Translation work must additionally read translation.md. Continue from next_action rather than reconstructing the roadmap from prior chats.
